title: A data-id attribute changes the heading ID in the table of contents
body:
I have a generated page with `
` followed by its first heading. The heading ends up with `toc_1_1`, even though nothing on the page actually has `id="toc_1"`. This breaks links from another document. Could the normal `add_toc_hook` keep `toc_1` in this case, while still using the suffix if a real `id="toc_1"` already exists? This is with raw HTML enabled. I also reuse the same Markdown instance across pages.
